_doc: The Rogue's sixteen arts (the user's list of 2026-11-12, docs/improvements12.txt, its seventh phase), written by 925 onto every map of the game as secondary abilities of the Rogue (FRDSecondaryDef with a Slot) and their manuals (items of kind Tome: 'Manual of <title>', Spell the art's name, Tiers its place's game tier, Weight 0: only its place's tome draw gives it, for her). place: the chain's index x 5 + the tier (Mistward 1-5, Vel Morrath 6-10, the War Engine 11-15, the Sewers 16-20, Kethrys Spire 21-25, Heaven 26-30), as the list sets them. dex: its cost in dexterity energy (her pool 100, back 1.5 a second; stealth 40), ours. cooldown: ours. values / values2 / seconds: its numbers (RD/RDRogue12.cpp reads each by its art: a share, a count, a multiple of her blade's or her crossbow's blow as her growth makes it); reach: how far it finds its monster or throws (cm); share: its round (metres). damage: whether it does damage (from her own weapons, growing as they grow: 'blade' or 'bolt') or holds its strength (a control: the list's 'the control effects would keep their strength, as her stealth does'). Looks by asset path, screened in 868 rogue12's pictures.

arts.name: Caltrops
arts.title: Caltrops
arts.text: Scatters spikes over {share} m: monsters crossing them are slowed {v}% and bleed

arts.name: SmokeBomb
arts.title: Smoke Bomb
arts.text: A {share} m cloud: monsters inside lose her for {v} s, with no dexterity energy spent

arts.name: Hamstring
arts.title: Hamstring
arts.text: A dagger cut that slows its target {v}% for {s} s

arts.name: MarkedForDeath
arts.title: Marked for Death
arts.text: Her target takes +{v}% from her for {s} s

arts.name: GrapplingHook
arts.title: Grappling Hook
arts.text: Hooks a wall or monster up to 20 m away and pulls her to it

arts.name: AcidFlask
arts.title: Acid Flask
arts.text: A thrown vial: a {share} m puddle that eats armour (+{v}% damage taken) and burns

arts.name: RicochetBolt
arts.title: Ricochet Bolt
arts.text: A crossbow bolt that bounces between up to {v} monsters

arts.name: ShadowDouble
arts.title: Shadow Double
arts.text: Leaves a copy of herself that draws monsters within {share} m for {s} s, then bursts

arts.name: FanOfKnives
arts.title: Fan of Knives
arts.text: {v} knives thrown in a ring, hitting everything within {share} m round her

arts.name: Flashbang
arts.title: Flashbang
arts.text: Blinds and stuns monsters within {share} m for {s} s

arts.name: Shadowstep
arts.title: Shadowstep
arts.text: Teleports behind her target and backstabs it with her ambush bonus

arts.name: GildedLure
arts.title: Gilded Lure
arts.text: A tossed coin: monsters within {share} m go after it for {s} s

arts.name: VanishingAct
arts.title: Vanishing Act
arts.text: {s} s stealth that survives her first {v} blows

arts.name: DeathLotus
arts.title: Death Lotus
arts.text: Spins, hitting everything within {share} m {v} times

arts.name: ThousandCuts
arts.title: Thousand Cuts
arts.text: Her last: marks every monster she can see within {share} m, then blinks between them, slashing each

screened: 868 rogue12fx (2026-11-14): the smoke is ShockWaves' 03 (a grey cloud billowing out; the smoke packs' own showed nothing on the castle's floor in 1.4 s or a thin plume); Shadowstep's black ash Desert Outpost's Smoke01 (a dark plume); the ricochet's streak and sparks Magic Projectiles' lightning (white-violet); the coin's glint the shooting star's hit; the flash a ring of our own (no ring system is white: ShockWaves' 01 blue, 05 yellow, 07 pink, 09 orange); CharacterBodyFX's coins, glass and bubbles and the bullet pack's glass showed nothing on their own; StylizedShields' shadow is a purple dome; ShockWaves' 03 is a ring of smoke rushing out (gone from the middle in a second): the smoke bomb's burst, its cloud our own puffs
